title: conoclinium ballotifolium
intro: Conoclinium ballotifolium, commonly known as Button Willow or Eupatorium, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Conoclinium ballotifolium include reducing inflammation, modulating the immune system, and exhibiting antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
